先停在叶子的表面。这里是挨在一起的上表皮细胞，还不是下面的叶肉。接着转到侧面，看: Pause at the leaf surface. These neighbouring cells form the upper epidermis, not the mesophyll beneath it. Next, turn to the side to see what lies below.
先观察同一取样位置的上表皮俯视图，再用正交侧转连接组织横切面。取样边缘不规则；侧: Inspect the same sample's upper epidermis from above, then turn orthographically to its tissue cross-section. The sample has irregular edges and exaggerated thickness. The viewing direction changes; cells are not deforming and mesophyll is not growing.
找找相邻细胞共同的边界。准备好后点“继续深入”，再看下面的叶肉。: Look for the shared boundaries between cells. When ready, choose Continue inward to see the mesophyll below.
点一下圆圈，走进叶片: One click takes you all the way inside
阳光里有许多颜色。绿叶中的叶绿素对红光、蓝光吸收较强，对绿光吸收较弱；反射和透过: Sunlight contains many colors. Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light more strongly than green. Green stands out in the light reflected by, or passing through, a leaf.
叶片的颜色取决于光谱吸收、组织散射与透射。叶绿素 a、b 对蓝光和红光有较强吸收: Leaf color depends on spectral absorption, tissue scattering and transmission. Chlorophyll a and b absorb strongly in the blue and red, and less strongly in the green. Green light is still used in photosynthesis.
叶子不是一张涂绿的纸。表皮下面有许多叶肉细胞，绿色的小颗粒藏在这些细胞里面。这里: A leaf is more than a green sheet. Beneath its surface are many mesophyll cells, with tiny green bodies inside. This cutaway opens the leaf like a slice of cake.
典型阔叶的叶肉常分为较紧密的栅栏组织与较疏松的海绵组织。含叶绿体的细胞参与光合作: A typical broadleaf often has tightly packed palisade mesophyll and looser spongy mesophyll. Chloroplast-containing cells carry out photosynthesis, while air spaces allow gas diffusion. Anatomy varies among plants.
这些小椭圆叫叶绿体，里面有叶绿素。中间的大空间叫液泡。如果这片叶子会变红，红色的: The little ovals are chloroplasts, which contain chlorophyll. The large space in the middle is a vacuole. In leaves that turn red, red anthocyanins accumulate mainly in the vacuole.
叶绿体分布在细胞质中，常被中央液泡挤到细胞周边。叶绿素和类胡萝卜素属于质体内的色: Chloroplasts sit in the cytoplasm, often pushed toward the cell's edge by the central vacuole. Chlorophyll and carotenoids are plastid pigments; water-soluble anthocyanins are stored mainly in vacuoles.
拖动季节，观察绿色小点怎样减少: Move through autumn to watch the green dots fade
叶绿体里有一叠叠小膜片。绿色的点代表叶绿素，黄色的点代表类胡萝卜素。到了秋天，绿: Inside a chloroplast are stacks of membranes. Green dots represent chlorophyll; yellow dots represent carotenoids. In autumn, the green dots fade and the yellow becomes easier to see.
叶绿素与类胡萝卜素位于类囊体膜中的光合色素蛋白复合体。衰老时，叶绿素被分解，膜系: Chlorophyll and carotenoids occur in photosynthetic pigment-protein complexes in thylakoid membranes. During senescence, chlorophyll breaks down and the membrane system is dismantled. The dots and membranes are enlarged symbols, not molecular photographs.
生长季中，叶绿素持续更新，绿色通常占主导；类胡萝卜素同时参与光能利用与光保护。: During the growing season, chlorophyll is continually renewed and green usually dominates. Carotenoids also help harvest light and protect against excess light.
夏天，叶绿素很多，绿色最显眼。黄色色素已经在叶子里，只是没有那么醒目。: In summer, abundant chlorophyll makes green stand out. Yellow pigments are already there, but are less noticeable.
日长变化、温度与植物自身发育共同影响叶片衰老。叶绿素分解加快，植物回收部分养分；: Changing day length, temperature and plant development influence leaf senescence. Chlorophyll breakdown accelerates and some nutrients are recovered. Cold air does not simply stain leaves.
白天变短、天气变化，许多落叶植物开始为休眠做准备。叶绿素逐渐分解，树也从叶子里收: As days shorten and the weather changes, many deciduous plants prepare for dormancy. Chlorophyll breaks down, and the tree recovers some nutrients from its leaves.
在能合成较多花青素的叶片中，花青素在衰老期间积累于液泡，叠加剩余色素形成红色或紫: In leaves able to produce substantial anthocyanins, these pigments accumulate in vacuoles during senescence. Together with remaining pigments, they produce red or purplish colors. Species, light, sugars and the vacuolar environment affect the shade.
这类叶子还会制造红色的花青素。放大到细胞里，看液泡变红；叶绿体里的绿色则继续减少: These leaves also make red anthocyanins. Zoom into a cell to see the vacuole redden while the green in its chloroplasts keeps fading.
叶绿素减少后，保留下来的类胡萝卜素使叶片呈黄至橙色。类胡萝卜素也可能减少；黄色显: As chlorophyll declines, retained carotenoids give leaves yellow to orange colors. Carotenoids may also decline; a more visible yellow does not mean more yellow pigment was made.
绿色退去，原本就在的黄色显现出来。这类叶子没有积累很多红色色素，于是秋天主要变成: As green fades, the yellow already present is revealed. These leaves do not accumulate much red pigment, so their autumn color is mainly yellow.
一片绿叶里面，藏着不止一种颜色。: A green leaf holds more than one color.
从外面，一直看到里面: From the outside, all the way in
叶片、细胞与色素示意图；讲解和操作在画面旁边: Illustration of a leaf, its cells and pigments; explanations and controls are beside the image
画面暂时无法显示。你仍可以操作季节和尺度，阅读旁边的讲解。: The illustration is unavailable. You can still change the season and scale and read the explanations.
色素条表示变化趋势，不是实测含量。: Bars show illustrative trends, not measured amounts.
为什么看起来是绿色？: Why does a leaf look green?
蓝光和红光吸收较强，绿光吸收较弱: Blue and red light are absorbed more strongly; green light less strongly
叶绿素吸收不同颜色的光，能力并不一样。绿光相对更容易被反射或透过叶片，所以我们常: Chlorophyll absorbs different colors of light unequally. Green light is relatively more likely to be reflected or transmitted, so leaves often look green. Green light also contributes to photosynthesis.
类胡萝卜素带来黄色到橙色。绿色很浓时，黄色不显眼；叶绿素减少后，它们的颜色便露出: Carotenoids give yellow to orange colors. Their color is less apparent when green dominates, but emerges as chlorophyll declines. Chlorophyll does not turn into yellow carotenoids.
有些叶子在秋天新合成较多花青素，积累在液泡中。并非每片叶子都先黄再红，也不是所有: Some leaves make substantial new anthocyanins in autumn and store them in vacuoles. Leaves do not all turn yellow and then red, and not every tree turns red. Plant variety and environment both matter.
带着放大镜去看一片叶子: Explore a leaf from the inside
先看夏天的叶绿体，再停在细胞这一层，把季节拖到秋天。切换两种叶子，比较：哪里失去: Start with a summer chloroplast. Then return to the cell view and move the season into autumn. Switch between the two leaf types: where does green fade, and where does red appear?
这是典型落叶阔叶的教学示意。层级间使用剖开和放大，不是显微镜实拍；形状、色素点数: This teaching illustration represents a typical deciduous broadleaf. It uses cutaways and magnification, not microscope imagery. Shapes, pigment dots and time are simplified. Evergreens also replace leaves, but do not all change color together. Later browning and leaf fall are not simulated here.
季节控制同步改变叶片、细胞和叶绿体中的色素状态。两种类型代表不同的变色路径，不对: The season control synchronizes pigment states across the leaf, cell and chloroplast views. The two types illustrate color pathways rather than predicting a particular species. Dots and bars are not concentrations or molecular counts.
红色花青素在液泡，不在这里: Red anthocyanins are in the vacuole, not here
花青素主要在液泡中；叶绿体近景只画叶绿素与类胡萝卜素。: Anthocyanins are mainly in vacuoles. This chloroplast close-up shows only chlorophyll and carotenoids.
绿色、黄色：叶绿体内。红色花青素：主要在液泡内。: Green and yellow: inside chloroplasts. Red anthocyanins: mainly inside vacuoles.
叶色来自吸收、反射与透射: Leaf color: absorption, reflection and transmission
叶片不是只吸收某一种颜色的滤片。色素的吸收光谱、细胞壁与空气间隙的散射、叶片厚度: A leaf is not a filter absorbing just one color. Pigment absorption spectra, scattering by cell walls and air spaces, and leaf thickness jointly shape reflection and transmission. Perceived color also depends on illumination and visual sensitivity.
在忽略荧光等波长转换的光能收支近似下，A、R、T 分别为同一波长的吸收、反射和透: Neglecting wavelength conversion such as fluorescence, A, R and T are absorbed, reflected and transmitted fractions at one wavelength. A green appearance does not mean zero green-light absorption.
先看整片叶子，再放大；比较外面看到的颜色和里面色素的位置。: View the whole leaf, then zoom in and relate surface color to pigment locations.
叶片颜色不能直接换算叶绿素浓度；光源、结构、其他色素与拍摄条件都会影响颜色。: Leaf color cannot be directly converted to chlorophyll concentration; lighting, structure, other pigments and imaging conditions matter.
典型阔叶的栅栏组织常较紧密，海绵组织含较多细胞间隙。二氧化碳经气孔进入后通过间隙: Typical broad leaves often have densely packed palisade tissue and more porous spongy mesophyll. Carbon dioxide entering through stomata diffuses through air spaces, while photosynthesis occurs in chloroplasts inside cells. This cross section is not universal across plants.
J 为扩散通量，D 为扩散系数，c 为浓度。菲克定律表达沿浓度梯度扩散的参考关系: J is diffusive flux, D diffusivity and c concentration. Fick’s law is a reference for diffusion down a concentration gradient; stomata, liquid pathways and biochemistry impose additional limits in leaves.
找细胞之间的空隙，再进入一个叶肉细胞：空隙和细胞内的大液泡不是同一部分。: Find spaces between cells, then enter one mesophyll cell: those spaces are distinct from its large vacuole.
放大过程改变了观察尺度，不表示叶片在现实中被层层掏空。: Zooming changes viewing scale; it does not imply that the leaf is hollowed out layer by layer.
叶绿素与类胡萝卜素位于叶绿体内的膜系统。花青素是一类水溶性色素，主要积累于液泡；: Chlorophylls and carotenoids are associated with membranes inside chloroplasts. Anthocyanins are water-soluble pigments stored mainly in vacuoles and can be newly synthesized in senescing leaves of some species. Molecular structure, vacuolar conditions and other compounds influence red and purple hues.
空间位置与化学性质相关。红色花青素不会因为放大到叶绿体，就出现在类囊体膜上；本页: Location is related to chemical properties. Zooming into a chloroplast does not place red anthocyanins on thylakoid membranes; separate compartments distinguish them here.
停在细胞层，切换能变红的叶子并拖到深秋，找出红色首先标在什么地方。: At cell scale, select a red-capable leaf and move to late autumn. Locate the compartment highlighted in red.
不是每片叶子都先黄再红；这里的两条路径代表不同能力，不是所有树共有的固定顺序。: Not every leaf turns yellow and then red. The two paths represent different capabilities, not one universal sequence.
类囊体膜、色素更新与衰老: Thylakoid membranes, pigment turnover and senescence
叶绿素和类胡萝卜素参与光合色素蛋白复合体；后者也参与光保护。衰老时叶绿素分解与膜: Chlorophylls and carotenoids participate in photosynthetic pigment–protein complexes, with carotenoids also contributing to photoprotection. During senescence, chlorophyll degradation and membrane dismantling reveal existing yellow pigments while some nutrients are recovered. Season, environment and species shape the process.
C 表示某类色素的量，S、L 分别为合成和损失速率。这个收支关系帮助区分“绿色减: C is a pigment amount, with synthesis rate S and loss rate L. This balance distinguishes declining green from increasing yellow; the illustrative curves do not calculate reaction rates.
比较叶绿素与黄色色素条：叶子变黄时，黄色色素不必变多。: Compare chlorophyll and carotenoid bars: a leaf can become yellow without gaining more yellow pigment.
圆点是放大的色素符号，数量不是分子计数；类囊体的精细结构也不是显微实拍。: Dots are enlarged pigment symbols, not molecular counts, and the thylakoids are not a microscope image.
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
为什么秋天绿色会减少？: Why does green fade in autumn?
叶绿素平时也会损耗，生长季里，叶子会不断补充。到了秋天，许多落叶植物开始衰老程序: Chlorophyll wears out even in summer, but growing leaves keep replacing it. In autumn, many deciduous plants begin leaf senescence: replacement slows and enzymes dismantle existing chlorophyll, so green gradually fades.
白天变短，温度与植物自身状态一起影响叶片何时开始衰老。不是一阵冷风把叶子染黄。: Shorter days, temperature and the plant’s own condition influence when leaf senescence begins. A cold breeze does not paint the leaf yellow.
叶绿素的补充跟不上分解，光合作用装置也逐渐拆解。树把其中一部分氮等养分收回枝干和: Chlorophyll replacement no longer keeps up with breakdown. The photosynthetic machinery is gradually dismantled, and the tree retrieves some nutrients, including nitrogen, into its woody parts and roots.
黄色显露，部分叶子变红: Yellow appears; some leaves turn red
原有的类胡萝卜素更显眼；有些植物还会新合成花青素。绿色并没有变成黄色或红色的另一: Existing carotenoids become more noticeable. Some plants also make new anthocyanins. Green chlorophyll does not turn into a different yellow or red pigment.
不同树种、光照、水分和温度会改变时间与颜色；这是一条典型的教学路径。: Species, light, water and temperature affect timing and color. This is one representative teaching pathway.
这是典型落叶阔叶的教学示意。层级间使用剖开和放大，不是显微镜实拍；形状、色素点数: A teaching illustration of a typical deciduous broadleaf, using cutaways and zooms rather than microscope footage. Anatomy, pigment marks and timing are simplified. Slow intracellular displacement and tiny particle movements are magnified; light marks represent energy transfer, not visible photographs of photons. Chlorophyll is bound in membrane protein complexes, not swimming freely inside chloroplasts. Evergreens also replace leaves, but not all in one synchronized autumn. Later browning and leaf fall are not simulated.
叶绿体里一叠叠的小膜片上有叶绿素。秋天，许多落叶植物开始收回养分，新的叶绿素补得: Chlorophyll sits on stacks of tiny membranes inside chloroplasts. In autumn, many deciduous plants start retrieving nutrients. Less new chlorophyll replaces what is being dismantled, so green slowly fades. Yellow pigments were already there: green does not turn into yellow.
可选择其他尺度，也可继续深入: Choose another scale or continue the journey
几至几十微米尺度 · 液泡剖开: Several to tens of micrometres · vacuole cutaway
拖动季节，看液泡里的红色逐渐积累: Move through the seasons and watch red pigment build up in the vacuole
这次我们走进液泡：细胞里一个装着水和许多溶解物的大空间。能变红的叶子会制造花青素: This time we enter the vacuole: a large compartment containing water and many dissolved substances. Leaves capable of turning red make anthocyanins and store them here. These pigments are not made by changing the green dots in chloroplasts into red ones. There is little red in summer; move to autumn to see what changes.
花青素经细胞质侧的生物合成途径形成，再通过膜转运等途径积累于液泡。它们属于水溶性: Anthocyanins are synthesized on the cytoplasmic side and accumulate in vacuoles through membrane transport and related processes. These water-soluble flavonoid pigments produce red to purple hues influenced by molecular structure, vacuolar pH and copigmentation. The tonoplast separates them from the cytoplasm and chloroplasts. Dots symbolize dissolved pigments.
红叶要看另一间“小房间”。叶绿体里的绿色仍在减少，但新出现的红色主要积累在中央液: For red leaves, we visit a different compartment. Green pigment is still declining in the chloroplasts, while the new red pigment accumulates mainly in the central vacuole. Next, enter the vacuole to see how anthocyanins give it a red color.
两种色素变化发生在不同区室：质体内的叶绿素分解，同时部分叶片新合成的花青素转运并: Two pigment changes occur in separate compartments: chlorophyll breaks down in plastids, while newly synthesized anthocyanins in some leaves are transported into vacuoles. This view illustrates an anthocyanin-containing mesophyll cell; other species may accumulate them in epidermal or other cells.
花青素的合成、转运与液泡积累: Anthocyanin synthesis, transport and vacuolar accumulation
花青素的合成发生在细胞质侧，合成后经转运等途径进入液泡。液泡内的水溶性色素会选择: Anthocyanins are synthesized on the cytoplasmic side and then enter vacuoles through transport and related processes. These water-soluble pigments selectively absorb visible light and contribute to red or purple leaf color. Chlorophyll degradation in chloroplasts is a separate process occurring alongside it.
细胞质侧合成 → 转运 → 液泡积累: Synthesis on the cytoplasmic side → transport → vacuolar accumulation
液泡膜是一层有选择性的边界。图中红色渐深表示积累趋势；漂动的小点只表示溶解状态，: The tonoplast is a selective boundary. Deepening red illustrates an accumulation trend. Drifting dots symbolize dissolved pigment, not its actual molecular size, diffusion speed or transport rate.
比较夏天与深秋：液泡中出现红色，但周边叶绿体仍按绿色减少、黄色显露的过程变化。: Compare summer with late autumn: red appears in the vacuole, while surrounding chloroplasts continue to lose green and reveal yellow.
花青素并不是在液泡里从叶绿素变出来的。颜色也不能直接反推液泡的酸碱度；物种、色素: Anthocyanins do not form by converting chlorophyll inside the vacuole. Color alone cannot reveal vacuolar pH; species, pigment structure and copigments also influence the result.
红色花青素：在液泡的水溶液中。叶绿素与黄色色素仍在外面的叶绿体内。: Red anthocyanins: dissolved in the vacuole. Chlorophyll and yellow pigments remain in chloroplasts outside it.
红叶路线 · 看液泡中积累的新色素: Red pathway · new pigment accumulates in vacuoles
黄叶路线 · 看叶绿体中原有的黄色: Yellow pathway · existing yellow in chloroplasts
选择黄叶，最后走进叶绿体；选择红叶，最后走进液泡。把季节拖到秋天，比较：哪里失去: Choose the yellow pathway to finish inside a chloroplast, or the red pathway to enter a vacuole. Move the season to autumn and compare: where does green disappear, and where does red accumulate?
观察尺度 · 从宏观到微观: Scale · from the whole leaf to its interior
这是典型落叶阔叶的教学示意。滑条连续放大同一处剖开窗口；各层为了清楚展示而压缩了: A teaching illustration of a typical deciduous broadleaf. The slider continuously magnifies the same cutaway window. Scale differences between levels are compressed for clarity; this is not microscope footage or a proportional measurement. Anatomy, pigment marks and timing are simplified. Slow intracellular movements and tiny particles are magnified; light marks represent energy transfer, not visible photographs of photons. Chlorophyll is bound in membrane protein complexes, not swimming freely inside chloroplasts. Evergreens also replace leaves, but not all in one synchronized autumn. Later browning and leaf fall are not simulated.
拖动尺度滑条，可以随时停下或退回。: Move the scale slider. Stop anywhere or slide back.
拖近一点，找找叶面上挨在一起的小格子。: Move closer and look for the little cells that fit together on the leaf surface.
叶片转过来了：上面是一层保护它的表皮，下面藏着许多叶肉细胞。: The leaf sample has turned: a protective surface layer sits above many cells inside.
切面窗口慢慢打开：最外面是保护叶片的表皮，下面藏着许多叶肉细胞。: The cutaway opens gradually: a protective epidermis lies outside the many mesophyll cells within.
找找细胞边上的绿色小椭圆。它们叫叶绿体。: Find the little green ovals around the edge of the cell. They are chloroplasts.
把季节拖到秋天，看看绿色减少后，还能看到什么颜色。: Move the season to autumn. What color can you see as the green fades?
把季节拖到秋天，看看细胞中间的大空间怎样变红。: Move the season to autumn and watch the large space inside the cell become red.
叶子由许多细胞组成。慢慢放大，先看看它的表面。: A leaf is made of many cells. Move closer to explore its surface first.
叶子有厚度。表皮下面，一些细胞排得紧，一些细胞之间留着空隙。: A leaf has thickness. Under its surface, some cells sit close together, while others have spaces between them.
叶绿体里面藏着叶绿素，它让绿色很显眼。细胞中间的大空间叫液泡。: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which makes green stand out. The large space in the cell is called a vacuole.
叶绿素在这些小膜片上。秋天绿色减少，原本就在的黄色便更显眼。: Chlorophyll is held in these little membranes. As green fades in autumn, the yellow already there becomes easier to see.
有些叶子会制造红色色素，存进液泡里。绿色和红色藏在不同的地方。: Some leaves make red pigments and store them in the vacuole. Green and red are in different places.
叶面上的细胞网络: Cells fitting together on the surface
转过来看叶片的厚度: Turning to see the thickness of a leaf
沿同一处叶面转到侧面：表皮接在切面的上沿，下面是叶肉细胞。厚度经过夸大，便于看清: Turn sideways at the same patch: the epidermis meets the upper edge of the section, with mesophyll cells below. Thickness is exaggerated for visibility.
打开叶片内部的切面: Opening a cutaway into the leaf
先看表面，再看里面: First the surface, then the inside
沿着滑条找一找：许多细胞在哪里？绿色藏在哪里？到了秋天，什么改变了？: Follow the slider: where are the many cells? Where is the green? What changes in autumn?
芽中幼叶，慢慢展开: A young leaf unfolds from its bud
幼叶逐渐生长、展开，仍连在原来的枝条位置。这里从芽中的叶开始，不是从一粒种子开始: The young leaf grows and unfolds at the same point on the branch. This journey begins with a leaf in a bud, not with a seed.
记住这根枝条和这片卷着的幼叶。叶片展开后，面积增大，内部组织逐渐具备成熟叶的工作: Remember this branch and folded young leaf. As the blade expands, its area increases and its tissues develop mature functions. The deformation illustrates development; it does not simulate cell division.
拖到成熟绿叶，再回头看：枝条的位置没有换，新长出的叶缘仍属于这片叶。: Move to the mature leaf and back: the branch stays in place, and the expanding edge belongs to the same leaf.
根供应水，叶脉运输；有光时，叶肉细胞利用光能制造糖。活细胞白天和夜晚也都能呼吸。: Roots supply water and veins transport it. In light, mesophyll cells use light energy to make sugars. Living cells also respire during both day and night.

衰老不是一层新油漆: Senescence is not a coat of paint
日长、温度与植物自身状态影响衰老。光合作用装置逐渐拆解，一部分营养回到枝干和根；: Day length, temperature and plant condition affect senescence. Photosynthetic machinery is dismantled and some nutrients return to stems and roots; an abscission layer later develops at the leaf stalk.
绿色减弱后，原有黄色更容易看见；能变红的叶子还会积累花青素。黄色、红色是不同能力: As green fades, existing yellow becomes clearer. Leaves capable of turning red also accumulate anthocyanins. Yellow and red compare different capabilities, not two stages every leaf must pass through.
比较黄、红两路，再进入叶绿体与液泡。临近脱落时，叶柄与枝条的连接发生了什么？: Compare yellow and red routes, then enter the chloroplast and vacuole. What happens to the stalk's connection as the leaf approaches detachment?

这片叶没有消失，也不会变回下一年的幼叶。真实落叶随后会干燥、碎裂并被分解者利用；: This leaf has not vanished and will not become next year's young leaf. Real litter later dries, fragments and is used by decomposers; those ecological processes are outside this first model.

同一组水标记进入木质部。叶内蒸发产生的张力与水的内聚性，帮助维持这条连续通路。: The same tracked water cohort enters xylem. Tension from evaporation in the leaf and water's cohesion help maintain this continuous pathway.
水到达叶脉和叶肉。上方叶片也出现同一观察批次的标记；两幅图使用不同放大比例。: Water reaches the veins and mesophyll. The leaf above shows a marker for the same tracked cohort; the two diagrams use different magnifications.
水在叶内蒸发，水汽经气孔扩散出去。实心变空心表示相态变化，不是液滴直接从气孔喷出: Water evaporates inside the leaf and vapour diffuses through stomata. Filled-to-hollow markers indicate a phase change, not liquid drops spraying from pores.

叶龄改变形态，观察尺度只改变你从哪里看。: Leaf age changes its form; observation scale changes only your viewpoint.

这是典型落叶阔叶的教学示意。滑条连续放大同一处剖开窗口；各层为了清楚展示而压缩了: This illustrates a representative deciduous broadleaf. The scale control continuously enlarges the same cutaway; differences in scale are compressed, not microscope footage or equal-scale measurements. Shape, pigment counts and time are simplified. Internal movements are exaggerated and light markers represent energy transfer, not photographs of photons. Chlorophyll is bound to membrane protein complexes, not freely swimming in chloroplasts. Evergreen plants also replace leaves, but do not all change together. The same leaf unfolds and detaches from its branch in compressed time. Abscission and colour changes are illustrative; real wind forces, cellular collapse after death and litter decomposition are not calculated. Next year's leaf is a new leaf.
